title: Zero Gravity Saudi Arabian Baby Squid Pilaf
description: A malty, creamy, weeknight Saudi Arabian dish featuring baby squid, spherified for a unique texture, and dairy-free friendly

ingredients.name: baby squid
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Rinse the baby squid under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the saffron threads and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the malt syrup and cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Add the basmati rice and cook, stirring constantly, until the liquid is absorbed.
In a separate bowl, mix the sodium alginate and water to create a spherification bath.
Using a syringe, drop the baby squid pieces into the spherification bath and let sit for 30 seconds.
Remove the spherified baby squid from the bath and add to the rice mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
